Azeroth Survivors Exorcism Proc Paladin

Last updated: November 17, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Sairren spends 10 points in Holy, 10 in Protection and 31 in Retribution. Hammer of Wrath helps trigger Exorcism through The Art of War. Judgement gives the build another source of triggers.

Keep the three core spells available

Draft Exorcism, Hammer of Wrath and Judgement. The other slots in the shared plan are Consecration, Divine Shield and Holy Light. Sairren marks those three for banishment so the core spells receive more upgrade offers.

Choose upgrades by what slows the run

  • If Exorcism hits too few enemies, prioritize targets and damage on that spell.
  • If triggers are too far apart, look for Hammer of Wrath cooldown and targets. Compare Exorcism cooldown and Hammer of Wrath damage before investing in Judgement.
  • If survival limits the run, the author lists Animated Chain Necklace as a defensive alternative to an Exorcism amulet.
